name: OpenThai2.1-OCR-Markdown-20261118

lineage.how_derived: Thai fine-tune keeping Parse's boxes, classes, reading order and serving stack; v2.1 (2026-11-18) adds phone photos, nine more page types, LaTeX formulas, header/footer removal and blank-page skipping

purpose: Thai and English document pages to Markdown with tables as HTML (card).

license.name: OpenMDW-1.1 (inherited from NVIDIA)
license.notes: The repo LICENSE is the NVIDIA OpenMDW-1.1 text; same terms as nemotron-3.5-parse.

architecture.kind: encoder-decoder VLM as Nemotron 3.5 Parse: C-RADIOv4-SO400M encoder 439M plus 10-layer mBART decoder 191.8M
architecture.drafter: DFlash2 drafter (dflash2/, 0.18 GB) as in the base

variants.notes: v2.0.0 stays available as a revision tag

pc-12gb.notes: 2.7 GB against a VRAM budget of 9.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-16gb.notes: 2.7 GB against a VRAM budget of 13.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-24gb.notes: 2.7 GB against a VRAM budget of 21.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-32gb.notes: 2.7 GB against a VRAM budget of 29.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

mac-16-24gb.notes: 2.7 GB against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 2.7 GB against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 2.7 GB against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

weaknesses: the card itself says Typhoon OCR V2 2B is still ahead by 4.5 MDPBench points, most on photographed pages and tables, and further ahead on olmOCR-bench and OmniDocBench
best_for: Thai government and everyday documents on 0.6B
soft.maturity: model card renamed from OpenThai2.0 with new weights on 2026-11-18; 13k downloads

tona_fit.reason: Thai-only specialisation of a model we would judge on its own (nemotron-3.5-parse); the vendor concedes a larger Thai competitor is better. Not relevant to German users.

sources.note: README, config and LICENSE listing read
